# Docufast

> Docufast (Docufast Integrated Services Limited, RC 1893484, Lagos) helps people and businesses in Nigeria get affidavits, newspaper notices, CAC registrations and filings, and birth and death registrations online. A person checks every document before it is delivered to the customer's encrypted Vault, where it carries a QR code anyone can verify.

Key facts:

- Founded 15 February 2022. Registered address: Suite 100, Adebola House, 38 Opebi Road, Ikeja, Lagos. Founder: Ajibola Adeboye.
- CAC registered (RC1893484), SCUML registered (SC251840209), NDPC registered (NDPC/DCP/07770), SMEDAN registered (SUIN426476832438).
- Docufast is not a law firm and does not give legal advice.
- Every order follows six steps: service, details, quote, upload and verify, pay, done.
- Customers pay only on docufast.ng, never into a personal account and never inside WhatsApp.
- Support on WhatsApp: 0905 495 1918, Monday to Saturday, 8am to 6pm WAT.
- Digital notarization is coming soon. Prices are not yet published.

## Services

- [All services](https://www.docufast.ng/services): every service in one place
- [Affidavits](https://www.docufast.ng/services/affidavits): change of name, loss, age, marriage, student and status affidavits, sworn through the Lagos court system
- [Newspaper publications](https://www.docufast.ng/services/publications): change of name, loss of documents and incorporated trustees notices
- [CAC and compliance](https://www.docufast.ng/services/cac): business names, companies, incorporated trustees, annual returns, status reports and company changes
- [Typing, data entry and transcription](https://www.docufast.ng/services/virtual-assistant)
- [Vault, reminders and notarization (coming soon)](https://www.docufast.ng/services/notarization)

## About and trust

- [About Docufast](https://www.docufast.ng/about): the fact sheet, registrations and contacts
- [Verify a Docufast document](https://www.docufast.ng/verify): check that a document is genuine, unchanged and not revoked
